subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 2: Team Talk – Of course! Good plan!
outcomes: Understand a dialogue about getting ready for a trip.
Use the expressions Of course!, Good plan! and Thanks for your help.
Say who will bring each item and why.

tf.s: Frank and Majid are flying to London.
tf.why: Yes, they are going by plane.

tf.s: Frank is going to take a small rucksack.
tf.why: Yes, Frank will take a small rucksack.

tf.s: Majid needs to bring toothpaste, soap and shampoo.
tf.why: Frank will bring them and they can share.

tf.s: Good plan! means That's a good idea!
tf.why: Yes, we say it when we like an idea.
Yes, Frank will get it on his phone.

tf.s: We say Thanks for your help when someone does something for us.
tf.why: Yes, it is a polite way to say thank you.

tf.s: Good plan! is a way to say thank you.
tf.why: Good plan! means That's a good idea!

tf.s: The boys are going to London to practise English.
tf.why: Yes, that is the reason for the trip.

boxes.q: Who is going to take a small rucksack?
Why does Frank say: I'll take one?
boxes.why: Frank decides to bring an umbrella for Majid.

boxes.q: Which expression means That's a good idea!?
boxes.why: Good plan! shows you like the idea.

boxes.q: A: Are you ready for our trip? B: Of ___!
Your friend helps you pack. You say …
boxes.why: We thank people who help us.

boxes.q: How are Frank and Majid travelling to London?
boxes.why: Majid gets sweets for the plane.

boxes.q: Who has a problem with his passport?
Why don't the boys both need soap and shampoo?
A: Let's take the bus to the airport. B: ___
Why are the boys going to London?

hunt.q: Answer: Can I borrow a pen?
They go to London to practise …

mcq.q: Which three expressions are in the Team Talk?
o: Of course! Good plan! Thanks for your help.
I'm crazy about! I can't stand! I don't mind!
mcq.why: These are the Team Talk expressions.

mcq.q: What does Majid NOT need to pack?
mcq.why: Frank will bring them and they can share.

mcq.q: Which situation is right for Thanks for your help.?
o: A friend carries your heavy bag.
A friend asks: Are you ready?
A friend says: Let's go by bus.
mcq.why: We thank people who help us.
Of course! is a strong yes.

mcq.q: Your friend says: I'll bring the snacks for the trip. What is the best reply?
o: Good plan! Thanks for your help.
mcq.why: You like the idea and say thank you.

mcq.q: Your teacher asks: Can you help me carry these books? You say …
A: Let's check our passports tonight. B: ___
mcq.why: Good plan! answers a good suggestion.

mcq.q: How do we know the boys are going by plane?
o: Majid will get some sweets for the plane.
mcq.why: The plane is mentioned with the sweets.

mcq.q: Why does Frank ask: Are you sure you're ready for this trip?
o: Majid forgot about his passport and has no umbrella.

mcq.q: Why is sharing soap and shampoo a good idea on a trip?
o: You carry less in your bag.
